text: Done at 85354a3d as reference-implementation evidence (kind recorded in manifest): fslpy 3.29.1 FSL cases with qform/sform disagreeing in code AND handedness (sform-, qform-, scaling-selected; neurological and radiological), fslpy fromFlirt world<->world for 5 sheared src/ref pairs, nibabel 5.4.2 conformed Norig/Torig with nonzero c_ras. Real .nii files included. Verified by ConventionOracleSuite on JVM and JS. Correction to the review premise: per FreeSurfer MRIxfmCRS2XYZtkreg, Torig shares Norig's direction cosines, so tkr->scanner = Norig*inv(Torig) is a pure translation by c_ras=Norig*(dims/2) even for oblique volumes; the full geometry is still required to compute c_ras. CAVEAT: native mri_info on an oblique volume and native flirt outputs remain pending P4.02/P4.04 (no FreeSurfer/FSL/Docker daemon here).
